MISLABELLED BY THE BACKFILL, not by the run. selector=DEFAULT means NO tier selection was applied, so the product measures the WHOLE pool: harps EW is 247 lines in aggregate of which 9 ARE lab-graded (6 shallow + 3 deep). I tagged it UNGRADED, which asserts the complement of the lab set. Left standing, CONSISTENT — a subset of the 238 non-lab lines — would overlap it and the same lines would appear in two supposedly separate sub-products (RYA-946). Republished immediately as tier=ALL; the VALUES are unchanged and were never in doubt.

gaps.reason: EMPTY BY CONSTRUCTION, measured on all three arms 2026-08-24. Of the 70 Fe I lab lines in 6910-9199 A, ZERO sit above the 0.60 central-depth gate — the harness refuses with 'no graded line in this band sits above the EW depth gate' before any spectrum is read, identically for KP1984-molecfit, KP2005 and IAG. The depth split is a strong function of wavelength: near-UV 58 of 59 deep, VIS 109 of 176, red-optical 0 of 70. Red-optical's GRADED tier therefore IS the whole lab pool. Do not relaunch this as a missing run.

CRIRES+ Y GRADED is n=1 and the harness REFUSES it — measured 2026-08-26, not inferred. Of the 5 primary-lab Fe I lines in the Y arm (9913.180 DH14, 9944.207 DH14, 10142.844 DH14, 10216.313 RU14, 10435.355 DH14) only 10435.355 falls inside the conditioned 10280-10680 A window; the other four sit BELOW 10280, in the stretch Elgueta's window excludes. The harness refusal is correct and quotable: 'a pool of fewer than 2 lines cannot carry a line-to-line scatter, so its statistical term would be invented rather than measured'. Deep-graded is 0 in the same window. ⚠️ This is a WINDOW limit, not an arm limit: the Y arm spans 9796.5-10796.1 A and is telluric-clean below 10280 (0.00-0.26% of points below 0.5, vs 0.06-0.21% INSIDE the adopted window), so a widened conditioned derivative reaches n=5. That derivative exists (vesta_crires_plus_Y_9800_10796_normalized.csv) but is not yet a registered holding.
